messages.content: I need all pending and active mandates of users parath and bhanu

function.name: user_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a user based on the provided user name and the status of the mandates. This API is intended for use by partners to retrieve information about their clients' mandates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The full name of the partner's client for whom to fetch mandates.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched.

function.name: partner_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a partner based on the specified status. If no status is provided, all mandates are retrieved. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If left empty, mandates with any status will be retrieved.

message.reasoning:
We need to call user_mandates twice: once for parath, once for bhanu. Status should be "active" or "pending". But the function signature only allows one status at a time. We can call twice: first with status "active", then with status "pending". Or we could combine? The question: "all pending and active mandates of users parath and bhanu". So we need both statuses for each user. We can call user_mandates twice per user. That would be four calls. Alternatively, maybe we can pass status as "active" and get active mandates; then status as "pending" for pending. There's no combined status.

Thus we need to call user_mandates for parath with status "active", then for parath with status "pending", then for bhanu with status "active", then for bhanu with status "pending".

But maybe we can do it more efficiently: call user_mandates for parath without specifying status (default active). Then call again for pending. Same for bhanu.

Let's proceed. We'll call user_mandates for parath with status "active".
